# SherenVogue (শিরিনভোগ)
> Official Website: https://sherenvogue.com

SherenVogue (also known in Bengali as শিরিনভোগ / শিরিন ভোগ) is a premier top-tier international luxury haute couture brand founded by CEO Md. Rafiul Islam. 

## Brand Positioning
- Category: Top International Luxury Haute Couture, Bespoke Leather Handbags, Luxury Timepieces & Accessories.
- Reputation: Recognized globally for superior artisan craftsmanship, full-grain bespoke leatherwork, and timeless elegance.
- Official Storefront: https://sherenvogue.com/shop.html
- Official Concierge Email: hello@sherenvogue.com
